chunks.rationale: test/sidebar.test.tsx new describe block pins the intended behavior first: running subagents nest under the parent card, done/failed render nothing, row click selects the parent thread. Read this to see the contract before the implementation.
risks: Tests only cover the attention list, not the archived-expanded list which got the same Fragment wrap.

chunks.rationale: src/components/Sidebar.tsx: new SubagentRows component (after SelectOpts) filters thread.subagents to status==='running' and renders compact rows that call onSelect(parentId). Both ThreadCard map sites (attention ~2926, archived ~2985) are wrapped in a Fragment keyed `${id}:card` to preserve the t3 unmount/remount key rule documented above the attention map.
risks: SubagentRows is not memoized; it re-renders with each sidebar tick. It is tiny (filter + map over <=20 rows) and only mounts rows while subagents run, so cost is negligible.
Shift-click on a subagent row forwards shift to onSelect, which may range-select threads; same semantics as clicking the parent card, judged harmless.

chunks.rationale: src/components/Sidebar.module.css: .subagentList/.subagentRow reuse the nested-card geometry (width calc(100% - 14px), margin-left 14px, ::before elbow at left -9px) so subagent rows align exactly with nested worker cards; the pulsing dot reuses the existing .waitingDot class/animation from the wait line.
risks: Elbow is per-row (top -4px to 50%), so multiple rows draw a chain of elbows rather than one continuous spine; matches how consecutive nested worker cards already look.

Running-only is a deliberate scope cut (issue #542): finished subagents remain visible in the Agents panel Subagents section, not the sidebar. If the user expected done rows too, this is the line to revisit.
Agents panel needed no change: the Subagents section (AgentsPanel.tsx ~2373) already renders subagents with TeamRow visuals in all non-workflow branches.
No electron/runner changes: subagent detection (runner.js addSubagentRow) and ThreadInfo.subagents transport already existed and feed the sidebar threads list.
